definitions.explanation: The lowest surface of an object, container, or geometric shape. Used both in everyday contexts (the bottom of a box) and in mathematics (the base of a solid figure).

examples.english: To write one's name on the bottom of the box.

examples.japanese: {底面|ていめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}め→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Calculate the area of the base.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{円柱|えんちゅう}→円柱：05551_enchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{底面|ていめん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The base of this cylinder is a circle with a radius of five centimeters.

notes:
Composed of {底|てい} (bottom) and ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface, face). Used in both everyday and mathematical/technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {底面|ていめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧: area of the base
- {底面|ていめん}{積|せき}: base area
- {底面|ていめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{平|たい}ら→平ら：03399_taira⟧: the bottom is flat
- {底面|ていめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{滑|す}り{止|ど}め: non-slip on the bottom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧: bottom — more casual and general; the bottom of a bag, ocean, etc.
- ⟦{裏面|りめん}→裏面：18245_rimen⟧: reverse side / back — the opposite side of a flat object, not necessarily the bottom
- {下面|かめん}: lower surface — the underside, similar but less common

USAGE:
In mathematics, {底面|ていめん} specifically refers to the base of a three-dimensional figure such as a prism, cylinder, or pyramid. This is a common term in Japanese math education.
